shiftStart.title: Shift start
shiftStart.description: Local time your shift starts, HH:MM (24-hour)

shiftEnd.title: Shift end
shiftEnd.description: Local time your shift ends, HH:MM (24-hour); Linear writes are denied from then until the next start

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA zone such as Asia/Manila; empty uses the machine's zone

onShift.title: On shift
onShift.description: host: your permission mode decides every write; drastic: also ask before a delete, retire or cancel; ask: ask before every write
